item.title: Braves add catching depth, sign former Rangers All-Star Jonah Heim to $1.25 million, 1-year deal
item.description: NORTH PORT, Fla. (AP) — The Atlanta Braves added catching depth while awaiting the return of Sean Murphy by signing former Texas Rangers All-Star Jonah Heim to a $1.25 million, one-year deal on Tuesday.

item.title: Bulls' Collin Sexton fined $35,000 for inappropriate hand gesture during loss to Nets
item.description: NEW YORK (AP) — Chicago Bulls guard Collin Sexton has been fined $35,000 for making an inappropriate hand gesture during a game, the NBA said Tuesday. The incident happened during Chicago's 123-115 loss to the Brooklyn Nets on Monday.

item.title: Short-track silver for Canada; women’s hockey falls to U.S.; top pairs team in
item.description: Canada's women's hockey team suffered its first loss of the Milan Cortina Olympics as the United States blanked them 5-0 in Group A action Tuesday.

item.title: Short-track silver for Canada; Women’s hockey falls to U.S.; top pairs team in
item.description: MILAN — Canada's women's hockey team suffered its first loss of the Milan Cortina Olympics as the United States blanked them 5-0 in Group A action Tuesday.

item.title: Here's what happened each day of the Nancy Guthrie disappearance
item.description: New surveillance video of a masked and apparently armed person on Nancy Guthrie’s doorstep the night she went missing was released Tuesday by federal investigators.

item.title: Tigres pounce on Forge with three second-half goals to net 4-1 Champions Cup win
item.description: MONTERREY — Rodrigo Aguirre scored once in each half, Nahuel Guzmán stopped two of three shots and the Monterrey-based Tigres UANL defeated the visiting Forge FC of Hamilton 4-1 in the second leg of the first-round CONCACAF Champions Cup series.

item.title: Suns dominate Mavericks 120-111, extend Dallas' losing streak to 8 games
item.description: PHOENIX (AP) — Dillon Brooks scored 23 points, Devin Booker had 19 and the Phoenix Suns beat Dallas 120-111 on Tuesday night to send the Mavericks to their eighth consecutive loss.

item.title: Shapovalov wins, Diallo falls in first-round singles action at Dallas Open
item.description: DALLAS — Seventh-seeded Canadian Denis Shapovalov breezed to an opening-round victory at the Dallas Open on Tuesday night, bouncing Rafael Jodar of Spain 6-1, 6-2. The Richmond Hill, Ont., tennis star had seven aces in the 69-minute match.

item.title: Victor Wembanyama scores 37 of 40 in 1st half, leading Spurs to 136-108 win over short-handed Lakers
item.description: LOS ANGELES (AP) — Victor Wembanyama scored 37 of his season high-tying 40 points in the first half of the San Antonio Spurs' fifth straight victory, 136-108 over the short-handed Los Angeles Lakers on Tuesday night.

item.title: Pacers beat Knicks 137-134 in OT, snap 4-game losing streak
item.description: NEW YORK (AP) — Pascal Siakam scored 30 points, Andrew Nembhard had 24 points and 10 assists and the Indiana Pacers snapped a four-game losing streak by holding off the New York Knicks with a 137-134 overtime victory on Tuesday night.
